scope: Deployment extension for the frozen English B0 rater: complete int4-AWQ Mistral decode mathematics plus the already confirmed six-item mean and measured-call-rate formulas. The new decode formulas describe apparatus behavior; they do not change the scientific estimators or the approved design.
supersedes_note: Corrects the six defective rater_* entries of ENGLISH_EXECUTION_MATH_SPEC.json named in the english-b0-rater-v2 review (embedding defined from ids and a table; grouped-query output head count key_head*groups; EOS set membership; QK scaling and causal masking inside the attention expression; rotate-half and RoPE table construction defined; AWQ bit unpacking and group indexing specified) and adds the five material operations that carried no formula (QKV split and reshape axes, position-dependent RoPE frequencies, packed AWQ extraction with fused-GEMM equivalence, KV-cache content and position updates, vocabulary-parallel logit handling).

formulas.name: Packed AWQ int4 extraction
formulas.explanation: Each int32 word carries eight 4-bit codes; code k is read from bit offset 4*pi_k, where pi is the registered AutoAWQ interleave (0,4,1,5,2,6,3,7). The bound awq_extract operation returns the declared [rows, packed_cols, pack_factor] tensor. Its sole downstream adapter awq_unpack explicitly reshapes that tensor to the deployed two-dimensional [rows, packed_cols*pack_factor] weight layout, whose flattened column is pack_factor*c+k; awq_dequantize consumes that flattened result. The interleave is part of the stored format, not a project convention.

formulas.name: AWQ group indexing
formulas.explanation: Row i of the weight is dequantized with the scale and zero point of group floor(i/g). The group size must divide the input dimension.

formulas.name: AWQ dequantization
formulas.explanation: Centre each 4-bit code on its group zero point and scale it. The group axis is broadcast back to rows through the group index, which the previous specification left implicit.
formulas.expr: (unpacked_weight - np.take(unpacked_zero, np.mod(np.abs(group_index).astype(np.int64), unpacked_zero.shape[0]), axis=0)) * np.take(awq_scale, np.mod(np.abs(group_index).astype(np.int64), awq_scale.shape[0]), axis=0)
formulas.reference_expr: np.multiply(np.subtract(unpacked_weight, np.take(unpacked_zero, np.mod(np.abs(group_index).astype(np.int64), unpacked_zero.shape[0]), axis=0)), np.take(awq_scale, np.mod(np.abs(group_index).astype(np.int64), awq_scale.shape[0]), axis=0))

formulas.name: Fused AWQ GEMM equivalence
formulas.explanation: The runtime calls one fused quantized kernel. Its mathematical content is the dequantized matrix product: this identity is what the contract test checks against a scalar accumulation, and it is the claim the fused kernel must satisfy.

formulas.name: Embedding lookup
formulas.explanation: Gather the row named by each already validated token identifier. The abs/mod wrapper exists only to generate in-domain values for the deterministic shape checker; on the stated domain it is the identity, while embedding_lookup separately rejects invalid identifiers.

formulas.name: Root-mean-square normalization
formulas.explanation: Normalize each token over its hidden axis without mean subtraction, then apply the learned gain. The reduction accumulates at no lower precision than float32.
formulas.expr: norm_weight * norm_hidden / np.sqrt(np.mean(norm_hidden ** 2, axis=-1, keepdims=True) + norm_epsilon)
formulas.reference_expr: norm_weight * norm_hidden / np.sqrt(np.sum(norm_hidden ** 2, axis=-1, keepdims=True) / norm_hidden.shape[-1] + norm_epsilon)

formulas.name: Rotary inverse frequencies
formulas.explanation: The implementation constructs the half-width inverse-frequency vector in float64. The next formula duplicates its angle table explicitly before rope_tables flattens it.

formulas.name: Rotary table construction
formulas.explanation: The half-width angle table is duplicated as an explicit size-two axis before rope_tables flattens its last two axes. Position dependence is load-bearing and is tested directly.
formulas.expr: 0.0 * duplicate_selector[None, :, None] + position[:, None, None] * inverse_frequency[None, None, :]

formulas.name: Rotary cosine table
formulas.explanation: Elementwise cosine of the duplicated angle table.

formulas.name: Rotary sine table
formulas.explanation: Elementwise sine of the duplicated angle table.

formulas.name: Rotate-half
formulas.explanation: Split the head axis at its midpoint, negate the upper half and place it first. Previously this tensor was supplied as an undefined input symbol.

formulas.name: Rotary position embedding
formulas.explanation: Rotate each coordinate pair by its position-dependent angle. The inner product of a rotated query and a rotated key depends only on the position difference, which the contract test checks directly.

formulas.name: Fused QKV split and reshape, query part
formulas.explanation: The fused projection row is cut at h_q*d, reshaped to (tokens, heads, head_dim) and transposed to head-major order. Reshape precedes transpose; the other order interleaves heads with positions while keeping a compatible shape.

formulas.name: Fused QKV split and reshape, key part
formulas.explanation: The key block begins at offset h_q*d and is h_k*d wide; the value block follows it with the same width. Both reshape and transpose exactly as the query does.

formulas.name: Fused QKV split and reshape, value part
formulas.explanation: The value block begins after the query and key blocks, is h_k*d wide, and uses the same reshape-then-transpose ordering as the key block.

formulas.name: Grouped-query repetition
formulas.explanation: Elementwise head-index definition of the flattened grouped-query output. repeat_kv calls this selector for every validated query-head index q, so the returned head axis has key_head*r entries without retaining a separate group axis. The abs/mod terms only keep the deterministic checker in the validated domain.

formulas.name: Cache-aware causal mask
formulas.explanation: With a key-value cache the query block sits at the end of the key block, so query i occupies absolute position i + (n_k - n_q). Omitting the offset would let a decode step attend to nothing but its own row.

formulas.name: Scaled masked attention logits
formulas.explanation: The query-key product, its 1/sqrt(d) scaling and the additive causal mask now live inside the expression. The previous entry softmaxed a score tensor supplied from outside and therefore asserted nothing about either the scaling or the mask.

formulas.name: Attention distribution
formulas.explanation: Softmax over the key axis, shifted by the row maximum for stability. Each row sums to one, so every output is a convex combination of the visible value rows.
formulas.expr: np.exp(attn_score - np.max(attn_score, axis=-1, keepdims=True)) / np.sum(np.exp(attn_score - np.max(attn_score, axis=-1, keepdims=True)), axis=-1, keepdims=True)

formulas.name: Attention value aggregation
formulas.explanation: Contract the key axis of the distribution against the key axis of the group-repeated value tensor.

formulas.name: Unquantized projection
formulas.explanation: Row-major weight, contracting the hidden axis. Used by the norm-scaled head path, which is not quantized.

formulas.name: Residual update
formulas.explanation: Pre-norm residual addition; the hidden width is preserved.

formulas.name: Gated SiLU feed-forward
formulas.explanation: SiLU-gate the gate projection, multiply elementwise by the up projection and contract with the down projection.

formulas.name: Key-value cache content update
formulas.explanation: Elementwise definition of concatenation along the dynamic sequence axis. The expression selects an arbitrary position from the concatenated cache, while rater_cache_recurrence separately states its length L+A. Batch, head and head-dimension axes are preserved. The contract test also checks that a split cached forward equals the whole forward.
formulas.expr: np.take(np.concatenate([cached_entry, fresh_entry], axis=-2), np.mod(np.abs(cache_position).astype(np.int64), cached_entry.shape[-2] + fresh_entry.shape[-2]), axis=-2)

formulas.name: Key-value cache length recurrence
formulas.explanation: The cached key length after appending a positions. A decode step appends one.

formulas.name: Cache-aware position update
formulas.explanation: A step whose cache holds L0 positions starts at absolute position L0. This is the link between the cache and the rotary tables: a step decoded at position 0 with a non-empty cache gives a different and wrong answer, which the contract test demonstrates.

formulas.name: Pre-norm decoder block
formulas.explanation: The block is two pre-norm residual branches: normalize, attend, add; normalize, feed forward, add. Zeroing both output projections must return the input unchanged, which is how the contract test pins the residual structure rather than merely the shapes.

formulas.name: Rank-ordered vocabulary-logit shards
formulas.explanation: Elementwise definition of rank-ordered vocabulary concatenation for two shards. vocabulary_parallel_logits calls the bound selector for every validated vocabulary index, flattening the shard axes into one full-vocabulary axis; the executable test proves equality with the whole head and proves rank order is load-bearing.
formulas.expr: np.where(vocabulary_index < shard_logits_a.shape[-1], np.take(shard_logits_a, np.mod(np.abs(vocabulary_index).astype(np.int64), shard_logits_a.shape[-1]), axis=-1), np.take(shard_logits_b, np.mod(np.abs(vocabulary_index - shard_logits_a.shape[-1]).astype(np.int64), shard_logits_b.shape[-1]), axis=-1))

formulas.name: Language-model head
formulas.explanation: Project the final-normalized hidden states onto the vocabulary.

formulas.name: Greedy token selection
formulas.explanation: Final-axis argmax, taking the first maximum so that ties are deterministic. The project owns this selection and forces the runtime sampler to it.

formulas.name: End-of-sequence stopping
formulas.explanation: Stop when the selected token is a MEMBER of the checkpoint-declared terminal set. The deployed checkpoint currently resolves that set to the singleton {2}; set-membership remains the runtime contract so any future artifact-bound terminal set is handled without changing the formula.

formulas.name: Checkpoint grouped-query ratio
formulas.explanation: The frozen checkpoint must declare a positive query-head count exactly divisible by its key/value-head count. key_value_group_count enforces that domain before returning this ratio.

formulas.name: Equal-weight six-item trait score
formulas.explanation: Every English behavior trait score is the mean of its six integer rubric items; this is copied unchanged from the confirmed English execution specification.

formulas.name: Measured model-call throughput
formulas.explanation: The executor divides completed model calls by positive elapsed seconds; this is copied unchanged from the confirmed English execution specification.
